headline: nfl_advanced_stats drops one on an HTTP 500 from the provider
detail: The Tuesday slot failed after 3 retries in 2.1 seconds. Previous run loaded 4,312 rows.

headline: nfl_games extends its win streak to six
detail: 321 rows in 61 seconds this morning. The streak dates to last Sunday's recovery.

headline: NFL models rebuilt twice before noon
detail: Both builds drained one load each and finished in 47 and 49 seconds, 75 queries apiece.

headline: 14,882 NFL rows landed across four pipelines by the noon wire
detail: All four NFL ingestion pipelines completed their scheduled loads.

headline: All-quiet Friday: every slot filled, every build green
detail: Nine ingestion runs succeeded and two dbt builds completed. No alerts fired.
